# CRM Market Size & Data Standards

| Indicator | Value and scope | Interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| China software industry | 2025 software business revenue was approximately RMB 15.4831 trillion, up 13.2%; information-technology service revenue grew 14.7%. | Indicates the digital customer pool and IT spending base, not CRM SaaS TAM. |
| Global CX and relationship software | Gartner estimated approximately USD 128 billion in 2024, up 13.4%. | Broad category; it includes more than sales CRM. |
| CRM sales software | Gartner estimated approximately USD 28.7 billion in 2025 and about 12.8% CAGR through 2029. | A sales-CRM category estimate; retain its global scope and methodology. |
| China cross-border e-commerce | 2025 cross-border e-commerce import/export was reported at approximately RMB 2.84 trillion. | Proxy for cross-border B2B/B2C activity; it is not a B2B CRM market size. |
| Data handling rule | Do not combine annual, half-year, regional, category or vendor figures as if they were one series. | Every figure must retain year, geography, publisher, methodology and category scope. |
